description: Discover Rothco’s Lightweight Woobbie Duffle Bag, the perfect solution for storing clothes, small sports gear, travel essentials, and more. Whether you’re going to the gym or out traveling, keep your possessions safe and secure. The quilted duffle bag has a 22L capacity and measures 19 inch x 9.5 inch for ample storage space. With the Woobie Duffle Bag you can be sure you have what you need, when you need it. From Tactical Roots to Everyday Utility: Inspired by the dependable versatility of the iconic poncho liner, Rothco’s Woobie collection embodies rugged style and practicality. Each item, from our durable outerwear to premium duffle bags, features a distinctive quilted pattern and lightweight filling, combining unique style with everyday functionality. Fast & Easy Access: The gym bag features a main compartment with a full-length, two-way zipper closure for quick access to your travel accessories and everyday carry essentials. The multifunctional duffle bags include 1 inner zipper pocket and 1 outer side zipper pocket for organizing small items. Carry Options: These lightweight duffle bags come equipped with dual carry handles, a grab handle on the end, and an adjustable shoulder strap that extends up to 52 inches for comfortable carry. The shoulder strap can be removed, allowing you to easily store the Woobie bag in your car or a larger pack. Versatile Design: Built for both men and women, the overnight duffle bag is great for traveling, trips to the gym, sports, commuting, everyday use, and more.
